about.what: Berth points ESTIMATED from EarthAtlas's own AIS positions (Josh 2026-09-28), for terminals with several berths but only one citable position. Never an official position: stored as terminal_berths basis 'ais_inferred' (source 'earthatlas-ais-berths', evidence class inferred) and labelled "estimated from AIS stops" on the card.
about.method: scripts/ships/bake-ais/berth_stops.py: long stops of large ships (MarineCadastre AIS, CC0; SOG < 0.5 kn for 2 h+, length >= 100 m as broadcast; position = median, spread = 90th percentile). scripts/ships/ais-berths.mjs + lib/ships/aisBerths.js: stops that spread <= 50 m are clustered (densest stop seeds a cluster of the stops within 60 m of its median); a cluster becomes a berth of terminal T only if it passes the footprint guard.
about.guard: 1) the cluster centre lies inside T's own mapped footprint (the OpenStreetMap site / pier elements listed under footprints) or within 80 m of it (a moored ship's AIS position lies alongside the quay); 2) no other terminal's footprint and no other named mapped facility (OSM industrial site or pier) is within 80 m or closer than 2x T's distance (else ambiguous, not attributed); 3) >= 80% of its stops are by ships whose AIS type fits T (70-79 cargo at dry bulk / grain; 80-89 tanker where T handles liquids); 4) >= 10 stops by >= 5 different ships; 5) outside every existing official / OSM berth radius of T (inside one, those ships are already counted).
about.positions: lat/lon = the cluster centre (median of the stop positions), from AIS (CC0). The OSM footprint only decides WHICH terminal a cluster belongs to; no OSM coordinate is copied into a berth position.
about.official_lists: The port authority and the pilotage authority publish berth lists (names, lengths, depths) for these terminals, but their terms of reuse are unclear or all-rights-reserved (flagged to Josh 2026-09-28), so nothing from them is stored here.
about.proposal: scripts/ships/ais-berths.mjs run 2026-09-29 UTC (stops 2025-07-01 … 2026-06-30, 365 days; OSM base 2026-09-29T03:17:16Z): 3 accepted, 23 rejected; reviewed by hand 2026-09-28.
